title: ''Cooking Master' 22lb Digital Kitchen Scale,Food Scale Measures in Grams and Ounces for Weight Cooking Baking,1g/0.1oz Precise Graduation,Stainless Steel and Tempered Glass
description:
About this item
Precise Weight: Accurate, elegant;easy-to-use digital kitchen scale for your largest and smallest cooking projects - weighs up to 22.04 lbs (10000 grams) with precise graduations of 0.1 oz (1 gram)
Measuring Range: 0.1oz to 22 lbs (2g/3g to 10kg). we tested each scale with calibrated five-gram, 10-gram, 100-gram, and 500-gram weights;The weights were tested multiple times on the centers of; every measurement was accurate
Multifunction: Automatic Unit Button instantly converts between 6 units of measurements (kg g lb:oz fl.oz ml) and displays results on an Lcd screen - e.g. easily convert 1078 grams to 2.376 pounds to 2 pounds 6 ounces to 38.02 ounces to 1078 ml
Zero/Tare Function: Convenient tare button for tare calculation you to subtract the weight of plate or container;easy to achieve accurate readouts of ingredients;food scale for kitchen comes with auto and manual shut off function which save battery life
Practical Design: Food scale is designed with tempered glass for strong bearing; sleek stainless steel surface for anti-fingerprint and easy clean for convenient storage;It can resist staining and food carry over and helps to weigh things accurately
Kitchen Helper: Built-in high-precision load sensor;are made of safe materials and are ideal for professional chefs and home cooks to achieve your health goalsplace this kitchen scale at home, deli, bakery or restaurant to better control food
Note: The surface of the kitchen scale is silver, and the surface is affixed with 1 to 2 layers of blue protective film; to prevent it from being scratched during transportation;please peel off the blue protective film on the surface before use

reviews_5s: This is a great lightweight kitchen scale and is very easy to read. Love that it's waterproof and easy to clean, and provides multiple weight choices for liquids or solids. Would highly recommend!this scale is SO much better than the one i upgraded from. the biggest thing i was looking for, along with accuracy, is a scale with well lit numbers. This one is super easy to read and see. I love it!Very simple to use just got it today. I’ve already made three loaf of sourdough bread. Thank you very much.I love it! I bought this to replace my other scale that broke and let me tell you that it was a very welcomed upgrade. The bigger size helps so I fit bigger bowls and even large dinner plates and I can still see the numbers fine and I’m confident its accuracy is accurate. Great for cutting or bulking on a calorie surplus. Great product recommend it to everyoneJust received it, using it for baking, so far so good. Showing accurate weight, lights up quickly, easy to use. Time will tell!Great kitchen tool! Seems to be sturdy and accurate!Love love loveSturdy and big surface area for placement of foodLightweight, easy to read display. Nice appearance and comes with batteries.It is beautiful in a sleek gadget way. The numbers easy to read. It is easy to clean and I like the option to hang it.
reviews_1s:
Click to play video
I normally never write a bad review. I purchased this scale Oct 15th 2024. As you can see in the video it’s clearly defective. The top stainless steel surface separated from the scale just 4 months after buying it and using it once or twice a week.

I’ve tried contacting the manufacturer using their “customer support” tab. But all that is a drop down menu of a few normal procedures for trouble shooting. There’s no way to reach anyone live. I would have been satisfied with a replacement at least.
So beware! There are better options for scales out there with great customer support.Worked fine at first. Only 2 months old. Very inaccurate. Turn it on and place object on the scale and it turns off or won’t zero (tare). Also, I’ll have it on lbs and oz and it will change to grams or kilograms or whatever it feels like at the moment. I purchased because of the high rating! What a joke!I bought this back in 2021 and ended up leaving the country for missions. I never opened the box and today after being back home for a month and getting my things out of storage I opened the box took off the plastic sleeve out in some new AAA batteries and turned it on. While I was going thru the settings it stopped working. I thinking the batters I had were somehow bad skipped it over to see black marks on the white plastic. It shorted out and I never got to use it. Not sure if they are all junk but I certainly did not have a good experience. If the company works something out with me I'll update the review.The buttons were kind of wonky but it seemed to work OK most of the time. It was hard to zero out and often required multiple pushes on the button but not enough to warrant writing a review about. Here we are three months later and some water must've trickled in under the battery cover- which for whatever reason lacks any kind of gasket to protect against this- and the screen is completely swamped and unreadable. It seems like it maybe still is working as the buttons do change the display but in no way that makes it usable. I get that it's not listed as water proof but a cheap little foam gasket in the battery tray would go a long way to making this thing not a cheap throw away item.UselessThe only good thing about this device is that the buttons are tap activate no need to press and hold but this scale is not good. It's not accurate, and it's slow. It also has no decimals for grams, and measuring anything light weight is an absolute nightmare.

For example, I use my food scale to measure ingredients for baking. baking soda, baking powder, yeast, you cannot get an accurate measurement for these. you can have 2-3 grams of baking powder in a container on the scale and it'd still show 0. I have tested this with my old scale. This scale is literal garbage.

I bought this awhile ago just in case my other scale breaks. Little did I know my brand new back up scale is more broken than an old broke scale. *insert 10 eye roll emoji hereFar left is not to scale, does NOT have accurate measurements, all three left sides (top, mid, bottom) show a small variance. Enough to hit us with a violation from Food and Safety for having an inaccurate scale.So the picture for the scale seems to imply that the scale is waterproof. It's not. If you were to wash it as the picture shows it would short out. There are two holes in the white base, and looking in the holes, you can see wiring and other internals. One hole seems to be a hole for a non existing usb port, and the other hole appears to be a plastic scale hook (to measure bags). Finally, looking at the juncture of the glass top and plastic bottom, you can see a large gap, that again reveals the innards. Returned but Amazon didn't want the item back, so I assume many others have noticed this defect, but have not posted a review. Posting so that you can skip this item.Purchased in November 2023 and it stopped working a week ago (about two weeks after the return window closed of course). My husband uses a scale everyday and he was really happy with this scale until it stopped working. As of last week, the scale has been completely inaccurate, for example: 6 oz of rice showed as over 5 pounds. Each time my husband tried to check the scale again, it gave a different number. Really disappointing because we had thoroughly enjoyed it while it lasted.Despite reading negative reviews, I decided to give this scale/seller a chance. However, this scale is extremely faulty. I don't know if this is just my experience, but when I try to zero out the scale, the number start malfunctioning and random numbers start popping up. Especially when there are heavy items on the scale, it starts glitching and cannot properly zero out. My job requires me to know precise measurements and this just is not ideal. Not to mention, the buttons are sort of touch screen style, and I need to press each button about 4 times for it to work. Overall, it barely functions and its impractical. I would definitely encourage another brand.
